scientific_target.question: Can a frozen method identify the instructed overt-gaze flicker target from a four-second EEG epoch for an entirely held-out person, beyond constant and frequency-mapping controls?
scientific_target.known_answer: One of four source labels ordered1up,2left,3right,4down; corresponding nominal reference frequencies60/[5,7,9,11]Hz.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Original OpenBMI SSVEP target instruction joined privately to each query; gaze, cue position and frequency are experimentally coupled and photodiode-verified per-trial frequency is not established.
scientific_target.case_unit: One float32[10,400] EEG epoch;400 queries per held-person fold across both sessions/acquisition phases.
scientific_target.independent_unit: 54 human participants with trials nested in session×phase; training people overlap heavily across folds.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective instructed overt-gaze target decoding from declared source-derived observations; eye position and visual cue responses can contribute.
exclusions: No covert-attention, cue-independent intention, clinical efficacy or phase-specific longitudinal adaptation claim.
No original MATLAB preprocessing parity or source-paper accuracy qualification from this new400half-open-block representation.

primary.name: Declared equal-person/session/acquisition-phase/class mean recall
primary.aggregation: Argmax four raw scores in fixed source class order, ties earliest class; retain216 phase confusion matrices/supports, average classes→phases→sessions→54 people equally. Protected scorer body is not delivered under this task.

comparators.name: Unfitted two-harmonic CCA
comparators.inputs: Same ten-channel400 sample epoch and nominal frequencies60/[5,7,9,11]Hz; no training labels.
comparators.procedure: Pinned reference centers/scales and computes rank-aware orthonormal spans, then maximal canonical correlation to sine/cosine first/second harmonic columns. Constant/rank-zero epochs yield zero scores. Implemented but not run on authentic EEG.

comparators.name: Constant-score context baseline
comparators.inputs: No per-trial labels/cue/timing; four zero scores.
comparators.procedure: Use reference --mode constant; earliest-class ties retained. The public representation exposes no useful trial timing metadata.

comparators.name: Frequency-column permutation diagnostic
comparators.procedure: Rotate four CCA score columns left by one; keep original labels/IDs. A diagnostic for frequency mapping, not a neural-mechanism or randomization p-value.
